title: Deep learning enables urban change profiling through alignment of historical maps
abstract: arXiv:2602.02154v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Prior to modern Earth observation technologies, historical maps provide a unique record of long-term urban transformation and offer a lens on the evolving identity of cities. However, extracting consistent and fine-grained change information from historical map series remains challenging due to spatial misalignment, cartographic variation, and degrading document quality, limiting most analyses to small-scale or qualitative approaches. We propose a deep-learning-based framework for fine-grained urban change analysis from large collections of historical maps, built on a modular design that integrates spatial map alignment, multi-temporal object extraction, and change estimation. This framework shifts the analysis of historical maps from ad hoc visual comparison toward systematic, quantitative characterization of urban change. Experiments demonstrate the robust performance of the proposed alignment and object extraction methods. A

translated_title: 深度学习通过历史地图对齐实现城市变化特征分析
translated_abstract: 在现代对地观测技术出现之前，历史地图为长期城市变迁提供了独特的记录，也是观察城市不断演变的特征的一个视角。然而，由于空间错位、制图差异以及文档质量退化等问题，从历史地图系列中提取一致且细粒度的变化信息仍然具有挑战性，这使得大多数分析只能局限于小规模或定性的方法。我们提出了一种基于深度学习的框架，用于从大规模历史地图集合中进行细粒度的城市变化分析，该框架采用模块化设计，集成了空间地图对齐、多时相目标提取和变化估计。该框架将历史地图分析从临时的视觉比较转向系统的、定量的城市变化特征描述。实验证明了所提出的对齐和目标提取方法的鲁棒性能。
tldr: 提出了一种基于深度学习的模块化框架，通过空间地图对齐、多时相目标提取和变化估计，实现了从大规模历史地图集合中进行细粒度、定量的城市变化分析。
en_tdlr: A modular deep learning framework integrating spatial map alignment, multi-temporal object extraction, and change estimation enables fine-grained, quantitative urban change profiling from large historical map collections.
